classes.name: Browser
classes.description: Represents a browser instance in Playwright, managing contexts, pages, and low-level browser operations.

methods.description: Static method to get Browser instance from channel object.

methods.description: Initializes a new Browser instance with given parent, type, GUID, and initializer.
